title: Externally reviewed EnterpriseOps training trajectory
$comment: Receipt contract v2 migration: existing count-only receipts are insufficient. Obtain actual indexed verifier outcomes and bind the canonical public task input. Do not invent outcomes or merely backfill hashes to mark old receipts accepted.
description: One real complete trajectory per frozen training task. This schema supplies no demonstrations. Top-level administrative metadata is never model input. prepare_sft.py performs additional role/tool, receipt, membership, mask and rendering checks.

messages.description: Must begin with the exact system_prompt and user_prompt from the canonical training task. Later messages may only be assistant/tool turns; no substituted or additional user instructions.

tools.description: Actual native tool schemas visible to the agent. The unique function-name set must equal the canonical selected_tools exactly. Preserve native descriptions; live server/schema and argument correctness still require environment verification. Never include SQL verifiers or hidden administrative tools.

model_visible_sha256.description: SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON {messages,tools}: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no NaN. The supplied review must attest to this exact payload.

task_input_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical public training input object with exactly task_id, domain, system_prompt, user_prompt, selected_tools and restricted_tools. Use the same UTF8 canonical JSON settings as model_visible_sha256.

verifier_receipt.description: Existing v2 JSON receipt; relative paths resolve beside the source JSONL. Must bind the canonical public task input, full normalized verifier-list hash, and every indexed verifier outcome. See verifier_receipt.schema.json. Merely writing passed/accepted does not independently verify correctness.
